_comment: Harness defaults; personal overrides go in settings.local.json (gitignored). `model` + `effortLevel` mirror config models.session {model, effort} (/harness-doctor check 10 checks agreement); CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL and `claude --effort` override effortLevel at launch. /harness-init appends the project's gate commands to permissions.allow (headless -p runs auto-deny anything non-allowlisted). The five guard hooks come from the installed lean-agent-harness plugin, not this repo. Why there are no deny rules on config/specs writes, and why hooks are a denylist not a sandbox: docs/sandboxing.md.
_worktree_note: One session = one worktree (CLAUDE.md 'Session isolation'). baseRef 'fresh' branches each session's worktree from origin's default branch (clean tree matching the remote); 'head' would carry local unpushed state. .claude/settings.json, permissions, the plugin, and .git/hooks all resolve through a worktree to the main checkout, so the guard hooks + pre-commit privacy guard apply inside it for free.
